turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to decide what to play with my little brother this weekend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a racing game with silly karts that we can both play on the same screen.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a building game where we make castles and explore caves together.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a dance game that uses the controllers, which would get us both moving around.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The kart racer is a classic for siblings, it's quick to pick up and really fun to compete. The building game is better if you'd rather work together than compete. The dance game is great for a laugh but might tire out fast.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, I'm a nurse applying for a job in a new hospital. How do I answer tell me about yourself without just reading my CV?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Think of it as a short story in three parts. Where you are now, one thing you're proud of, and why this job is the next step.
